scenarios.label: Independents unaligned
scenarios.description: Existing King and Sanders remain in Democratic caucus; all four modeled independent opposition contenders unassigned, matching stated campaign pledges without treating pledges as certain future conduct.

control.description: Existing King and Sanders remain in Democratic caucus; all four modeled independent opposition contenders unassigned, matching stated campaign pledges without treating pledges as certain future conduct.

scenarios.label: Independents caucus with Democrats
scenarios.description: Counterfactual: all four modeled independent opposition contenders join Democratic caucus; King and Sanders remain there.

control.description: Counterfactual: all four modeled independent opposition contenders join Democratic caucus; King and Sanders remain there.

scenarios.label: Independents caucus with Republicans
scenarios.description: Counterfactual: all four modeled independent opposition contenders join Republican caucus; King and Sanders remain Democratic.

control.description: Counterfactual: all four modeled independent opposition contenders join Republican caucus; King and Sanders remain Democratic.

limitations: Initial rerun: A computational forecast comparison; no demonstrated forecast improvement
Community identification: Not estimated in this baseline; no causal subgroup or composition attribution from toplines
Current scope: Audited source subset with visible uncovered races, not an exhaustive polling census
Public comparators: Descriptive only; no tuning to public win probabilities
